mapper.select: /***selectJobRunHstStatis***/ SELECT A.* ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(A.LAST_UPDT_DT_14,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS')AS LAST_UPDT_DT FROM( SELECT CAST(COUNT(A.JOB_ID) OVER() AS INTEGER) AS totcnt ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.JOB_ID DESC) AS rownum ,MAX(B.REG_DT) OVER() AS LAST_UPDT_DT_14 ,A.JOB_ID ,A.JOB_NM_KR ,A.RECIVE_INST ,A.RECIVE_SYS ,B.WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT ,B.WEEK_LINK_FAILE_CNT ,B.MNTH_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT ,B.MNTH_LINK_FAILE_CNT ,B.YEAR_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT ,B.YEAR_LINK_FAILE_CNT ,B.REG_DT ,CASE WHEN D.START_SUCCESS_DT != '' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(D.START_SUCCESS_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE '-' END AS START_SUCCESS_DT ,CASE WHEN D.END_SUCCESS_DT != '' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(D.END_SUCCESS_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE '-' END AS END_SUCCESS_DT ,CASE WHEN B.LAST_SUCCESS_DAY != '' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(B.LAST_SUCCESS_DAY,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS LAST_SUCCESS_DAY FROM JOB_MST A, JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS B, (SELECT UPDT_YEAR,UPDT_MNTH,UPDT_WEEK FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS WHERE REG_DT = (SELECT MAX(REG_DT) FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) C, (SELECT JOB_ID, MIN(PROCESS_START_DT) AS START_SUCCESS_DT, MAX(PROCESS_START_DT) AS END_SUCCESS_DT FROM JOB_RUN_DETAIL_HST WHERE 1=1 AND PROCESS_END_RSLT = 'S' GROUP BY JOB_ID ) D WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_AT = 'Y' AND A.JOB_ID=B.JOB_ID AND A.JOB_NM_KR=B.JOB_NM_KR AND A.JOB_NM_KR LIKE '%' || #{jobNmKr} || '%' AND (A.RECIVE_INST LIKE '%' || #{reciveInst} || '%' OR A.RECIVE_SYS LIKE '%' || #{reciveInst} || '%') AND B.UPDT_YEAR= C.UPDT_YEAR AND B.UPDT_MNTH= C.UPDT_MNTH AND B.UPDT_WEEK= C.UPDT_WEEK AND A.JOB_ID=D.JOB_ID ORDER BY A.JOB_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex} )A

/***selectJobRunHstStatisIndicators***/ /**최신 주/월/년 누적통계 *JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS(연계이력통계)테이블의 PK는 JOB_ID,UPDT_YEAR,UPDT_MNTH,UPDT_WEEK 4개이며 *JOB_ID를 제외한 UPDT_YEAR,UPDT_MNTH,UPDT_WEEK를 그룹핑 SUM하면 모든잡의 누적 주간/월간/년간 통계수치가 한번에 나오도록 설계되어있다. *RESTORE_JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS 프로시져 참조 *Percent계산은 쿼리에서할경우 0으로 나눌수없다는 오류가 생길수있으므로 자바 혹은 자바스크립트로 처리**/
SELECT A.* ,A.TOTAL_YEAR_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT+A.TOTAL_YEAR_LINK_FAILE_CNT AS TOTAL_YEAR_LINK_CNT ,A.TOTAL_MNTH_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT+A.TOTAL_MNTH_LINK_FAILE_CNT AS TOTAL_MNTH_LINK_CNT ,A.TOTAL_WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT+A.TOTAL_WEEK_LINK_FAILE_CNT AS TOTAL_WEEK_LINK_CNT FROM( SELECT A.UPDT_YEAR ,A.UPDT_MNTH ,A.UPDT_WEEK ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(MAX(A.REG_DT),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY.MM.DD')AS LAST_UPDT_DT ,SUM(A.WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT) AS TOTAL_WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT ,SUM(A.WEEK_LINK_FAILE_CNT) AS TOTAL_WEEK_LINK_FAILE_CNT ,SUM(A.WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_DATA_ROW) AS TOTAL_WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_DATA_ROW ,SUM(A.MNTH_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT) AS TOTAL_MNTH_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT ,SUM(A.MNTH_LINK_FAILE_CNT) AS TOTAL_MNTH_LINK_FAILE_CNT ,SUM(A.MNTH_LINK_SUCCESS_DATA_ROW) AS TOTAL_MNTH_LINK_SUCCESS_DATA_ROW ,SUM(A.YEAR_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT) AS TOTAL_YEAR_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT ,SUM(A.YEAR_LINK_FAILE_CNT) AS TOTAL_YEAR_LINK_FAILE_CNT ,SUM(A.YEAR_LINK_SUCCESS_DATA_ROW) AS TOTAL_YEAR_LINK_SUCCESS_DATA_ROW FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS A, (SELECT UPDT_YEAR,UPDT_MNTH,UPDT_WEEK FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS WHERE REG_DT = (SELECT MAX(REG_DT) FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 )B WHERE 1=1 AND A.UPDT_YEAR=B.UPDT_YEAR AND A.UPDT_MNTH=B.UPDT_MNTH AND A.UPDT_WEEK=B.UPDT_WEEK GROUP BY A.UPDT_YEAR,A.UPDT_MNTH,A.UPDT_WEEK ) A;

/***selectJobMntlyAccumulateData***/ SELECT COALESCE(A.UPDT_YEAR,(SELECT MAX(UPDT_YEAR) FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS)) AS GRAPH_UPDT_YEAR ,B.UPDT_MNTH||'월' AS GRAPH_UPDT_MNTH ,COALESCE(A.MNTH_SUCCESS_CNT,0) AS GRAPH_MNTH_SUCCESS_CNT ,COALESCE(A.MNTH_FAILE_CNT,0) AS GRAPH_MNTH_FAILE_CNT FROM( SELECT A.UPDT_YEAR AS UPDT_YEAR ,A.UPDT_MNTH AS UPDT_MNTH ,SUM(SUM(A.WEEK_LINK_SUCCESS_CNT)) OVER (ORDER BY A.UPDT_YEAR,A.UPDT_MNTH) AS MNTH_SUCCESS_CNT ,SUM(SUM(A.WEEK_LINK_FAILE_CNT)) OVER (ORDER BY A.UPDT_YEAR,A.UPDT_MNTH) AS MNTH_FAILE_CNT FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS A WHERE A.UPDT_YEAR=(SELECT MAX(UPDT_YEAR) FROM JOB_RUN_HST_STATIS) GROUP BY A.UPDT_YEAR,A.UPDT_MNTH )A RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(1, 12) AS UPDT_MNTH) B ON A.UPDT_MNTH=B.UPDT_MNTH ORDER BY B.UPDT_MNTH ASC

/***selectRealTimeJobRunHst***/ SELECT CAST(COUNT(A.EXEC_ID) OVER() AS INTEGER) AS TOTCNT ,A.EXEC_ID ,A.JOB_ID ,A.JOB_NM_KR ,B.RECIVE_INST ,B.RECIVE_SYS ,A.JOB_END_AT ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(A.JOB_START_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')AS JOB_START_DT ,(SELECT MAX(PROCESS_SN) FROM JOB_RUN_DETAIL_HST WHERE EXEC_ID=A.EXEC_ID) AS CURR_PROCESS_SN , (SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(A.PROCESS_NM_KR ORDER BY PROCESS_SN),'|') FROM( SELECT A.* ,B.PROCESS_NM_KR FROM JOB_PROCESS_SN A, PROCESS_MST B WHERE A.JOB_ID='2' AND A.PROCESS_ID=B.PROCESS_ID ) A ) AS ARRAY_PROCESS_NMS
FROM JOB_RUN_HST A, JOB_MST B WHERE 1=1 AND A.JOB_END_AT ='N' AND A.JOB_NM_KR LIKE '%' || #{jobNmKr} || '%' AND (B.RECIVE_INST LIKE '%' || #{reciveInst} || '%' OR B.RECIVE_SYS LIKE '%' || #{reciveInst} || '%') AND A.JOB_ID=B.JOB_ID ORDER BY A.EXEC_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT A.EXEC_ID ,A.JOB_NM_KR ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(A.JOB_START_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')AS JOB_START_DT ,ROUND(CAST(CAST(A.JOB_ELAP_TIME AS FLOAT)/1000 AS NUMERIC),2) AS JOB_ELAP_TIME ,coalesce(TO_CHAR( A.SEND_WRITE_LINE , '999,999,999,999,999'),'0') AS SEND_WRITE_LINE ,B.PROCESS_ID ,B.PROCESS_NM_KR ,B.PROCESS_SN ,B.PROCESS_END_RSLT ,B.PROCESS_ERR_CONT ,TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(B.PROCESS_START_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')AS PROCESS_START_DT ,coalesce(TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(B.PROCESS_END_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'FAILED')AS PROCESS_END_DT ,coalesce(ROUND(CAST(CAST(B.PROCESS_ELAP_TIME AS FLOAT)/1000 AS NUMERIC),2),0) AS PROCESS_ELAP_TIME FROM JOB_RUN_HST A, JOB_RUN_DETAIL_HST B WHERE A.EXEC_ID= CAST(#{execId} AS NUMERIC) AND A.EXEC_ID=B.EXEC_ID ORDER BY B.PROCESS_SN ASC;
